summary: Frontend-only test of the purchase-free iOS (Capacitor) mode at 390x800, logged in as testvendor. Native mode works: the html element gets class pmc-native. The only purchase button on real supplier pages (listing-feature-btn 'Get featured') is hidden with data-pmc-iap-hidden. 8 checkout-type POSTs (billing/checkout, billing/fee-checkout, doc-fee/checkout, /pay/x, payments/emd/checkout, vendor categories checkout, data-intel checkout, vendor-tenders subscription checkout) were blocked before any network request and showed the billing-managed message. A mocked 402 with a checkout_url showed the message, no 'Pay now' action and no navigation to Stripe or 'null'. A mocked priced consultancy service: 'Book & pay INR 5,000' (service-req-pay) hidden, 'Send request' and 'Cancel' visible. Free features stay visible and work: listing-save, saved alert create and delete, AI summary/readiness buttons (prices are currently 0, so labels read Free), app-share-btn, app-settings-btn, Delete my account link, sign out, lang-toggle, Ask PMC, Help, Start bid, Download pack, EMD statement, Sign out everywhere else, Delete my data. Web mode (no mock): 0 data-pmc-iap-hidden elements, no pmc-native class, listing-feature-btn visible, 402 shows the 'Pay now' toast, service-req-pay visible. Nothing changed on web. IMPORTANT test note: the mock from the brief (window.Capacitor={isNativePlatform:()=>true}) is OVERWRITTEN by the real @capacitor/core when the bundle loads. After that isNativeApp() returns false, so the guard install still runs but the axios blocking does not. Accurate simulation also needs window.CapacitorCustomPlatform={name:'ios',plugins:{}}. On a real iPhone this is not a problem because the native bridge exists.

ui_bugs.issue: When AI prices are above 0, the button labels contain the price (e.g. 'Summarise (INR 500)'). CUR_RE then hides BOTH buttons in native, so the AI tools page has no action button and no explanation. Today prices are 0 ('Free'), so this does not happen yet. Confirmed with a mocked /supplier-ai/prices.

integration_issues.issue: The blocked-checkout message and the 402 message appear in showApiError's error style, with the title 'Something went wrong' (plus '· HTTP 402' on a 402). It reads like a failure rather than an informational note.

integration_issues.flow: Payment calls not matched by isPaymentRequest
integration_issues.issue: POST /api/v1/payments/sandbox/confirm and POST /api/v1/consulting/requests with pay_now:true (ConsultingE redirects to r.checkout_url) are not blocked. Today they can only be reached through hidden buttons, so the risk is low. A defensive guard would help: skip window.location redirects to checkout_url when isNativeApp().

issues: The 'PREMIUM VISIBILITY' panel still advertises featured listings ('Featured suppliers appear first... for 30 days') even though its button is hidden. Consider hiding the whole panel in native.
The price text 'INR 5,000' stays visible on the service card (only buttons/links are scanned).

action_items: In native mode, do not hide the AI tool buttons when a price is set. Remove the price from the label (or show a 'managed by your organisation' note) instead of hiding the button, so the feature stays usable or is explained.
Optional: in native, show NATIVE_BILLING_MSG as an info toast instead of the 'Something went wrong · HTTP 402' error style.
Optional: hide the 'Premium visibility' panel on /vendor/listing and the service price text in native.

Optional defence in depth: guard window.location / window.open redirects to checkout_url (ConsultingE, BidSubmit, PurchaseGrid, etc.) with isNativeApp(), and add /payments/sandbox/ to isPaymentRequest.
critical_code_review_comments: nativeBilling.js: isNativeApp() reads window.Capacitor on every call. That is correct on a real device but means a test mock must also set CapacitorCustomPlatform (see the summary).
isCta only scans button/a/[role=button] and skips text of 60+ characters. A long pay button label, or price text in a div/span, is not hidden.
The MutationObserver does not watch attribute changes. A data-testid or aria-label that changes without a child/text mutation is not re-evaluated (low risk).
ID_RE matches any testid segment '-feature-' (e.g. a future 'home-feature-card'), which could cause false positives; SAFE_RE does not cover that.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted one saved alert 'TEST_native_alert' (id 6af11e768834ebe828935ac5) through the UI. Priced AI prices, the consultancy service and the 402 responses were mocked with page.route only, so no DB writes. No payments were made.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To simulate native use add_init_script: window.Capacitor={isNativePlatform:()=>true,getPlatform:()=>'ios'}; window.CapacitorCustomPlatform={name:'ios',plugins:{}}. Without the second part, @capacitor/core overwrites the mock and the axios guard is inactive. Interceptors can be exercised in-page via window.webpackChunkfrontend.push([[Symbol()],{},r=>req=r]); req('./src/lib/api.js').api. Routes /vendor/my-bids and /vendor/settings do not exist (they redirect to /); the real ones are /vendor/mybids and /vendor/account.
